$comment: Commit SHAs a build of this fixture produces. Format: a JSON object with three objects. 'branches' maps each branch build.py creates to its head commit SHA: 'main' holds the base commit, and 'owner-priya', 'owner-jun' and 'owner-sam' each hold one owner's fixed checkpoint. 'tags' maps each tag build.py creates to its commit SHA: '<branch>-checkpoint' is the owner's checkpoint before the fix, 'owner-priya-fix-analytics' and 'owner-priya-fix-messaging' are Priya's fixes for analytics' and messaging's code on main, which the merge plan's parts for those scopes name, and 'owner-priya-limit-five' is Priya's intermediate fix with a limit of five, under which the shared-device test still fails. 'fixes' maps the pytest node ID of each test that fails on the merged checkpoints to the SHA of the commit that makes it pass. tests/test_fixture_builder.py checks that a fresh build reproduces every branch and tag SHA; tests/test_fixture_reproduction.py checks the 'fixes' entries.
